item.title: JFrog Confirms OpenAI Models Exploited Artifactory Zero-Day Before Hugging Face Breach
item.description:

item.title: Cognyte Sells a Mobile Cell Surveillance Van
item.description: <p>Yet another Israeli <a href="https://www.forbes.com/sites/thomasbrewster/2026/07/13/israels-palantir-rival-is-selling-1-million-spy-vans-to-us-cops/">mass surveillance company</a>:</p> <blockquote><p>Made by Israeli surveillance company Cognyte, the tech simulates a mobile phone tower, which forces nearby phones to connect to it. That enables cops to keep tabs on any phones in the vicinity ­ whether they’re owned by a suspect in a case or not. Cognyte’s contract with the state of Texas reveals that the simulator, called FalcoNet, can be concealed within the vehicles, hidden in a backpack for on-foot missions or attached to a helicopter. It’s the same technology as the infamous Stingray, one of the original cell-site simulators made by defense giant L3Harris...</p></blockquote>
item.dc:creator: Bruce Schneier
